Angular application page

The shape Angular DevTools' page-world detector reads once a second: an element carrying ng-version (Angular), an __ngContext__ on it (Ivy), a major version of 12 or more, and a window.ng.getComponent function (development mode). The detector posts its finding to the extension's content script, whose worker swaps the tab's popup to popups/supported.html.
